title: CertainTeed CertaPlank and related rigid-backed sidings
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC report lists FSR 100 and smoke development 510 under CAN/ULC-S102.2-18 for CertaPlank Single 7-inch horizontal siding specimens.
facts.locator: CCMC 14769-R PDF, p. 9, Fire performance table and notes

facts.text: The NBC 2020 opinion classifies Article 9.27.12.1.(1) as Alternative for the evaluated products.
The report limits use to Part 9 buildings, excludes evaluation as insulated vinyl siding, requires EPS/XPS compliant with CAN/ULC-S701.1 and specifies an air space/furring installation.
facts.locator: CCMC 14769-R PDF, p. 3, Conditions and limitations

limitations: The fire results are specimen-specific additional performance data, outside the CCMC opinion.
